page: Microsoft Azure E20ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EADSv5 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz. The configuration includes 20 vCPUs derived from 10 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 160.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 768 GB local SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are present on this server type.

In benchmark evaluations, the AMD EPYC processor delivers strong single-core CPU performance, as demonstrated by stress-ng single-core results in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench scores, and Passmark CPU metrics fall within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks, along with Passmark memory scores, also align with average tier performance. For language model workloads, the server achieves strong text generation speeds with small 135M parameter models, but performance drops significantly to the bottom 10% for prompt processing on large 70B parameter models, highlighting a clear performance tradeoff for larger AI workloads.

The E20ads_v5 offers a balanced qualitative cost profile for memory-intensive workloads due to its high resource density, combining 160 GB of RAM with 768 GB of local SSD storage. This hardware profile is suited for memory-optimized applications, database operations, and moderate-scale data processing. The average database operations and Redis SET benchmarks support its application in caching layers and relational databases, while the average multi-threaded decompression and software compilation scores make it viable for general-purpose enterprise workloads that require a larger memory footprint without the need for dedicated GPU acceleration.
description: Microsoft Azure E20ads_v5 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 20 vCPUs across 10 physical cores, 160.0 GB of RAM, and a bundled 768 GB local SSD. Benchmark data shows strong single-core CPU performance and strong text generation speeds for small language models, while multi-core CPU, memory bandwidth, and database operations perform in the average tier. Conversely, prompt processing for large 70B language models is poor, representing a clear performance tradeoff. With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core and Premium Storage capability, this instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications requiring substantial memory capacity without GPU acceleration.
